_comment: Pre-registered decision criteria for E0. Read BEFORE E0 runs and hashed
into the run manifest, so the rule that follows from the outcome cannot be
chosen after the outcome is visible.
STATUS MUST BE 'registered' BEFORE E0 RUNS. Owner sets the bounds.
max_threshold_cv: if the worst cross-fold coefficient of variation of a
crossing threshold exceeds this, the primary attribution rule switches from
first_crossing to the threshold-free set and first_crossing demotes to an
max_degenerate_cells: how many (subset x type) cells may be constant,
saturated, or near-binary before the field is called unusable.
